raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the task without verification and conflated Keturah with Hagar, asserting “Abraham married Hagar (identified as Keturah),” which contradicts the primary text (Genesis 25:1) that names Keturah as the wife after Sarah’s death. This reflects a misinterpretation and overreliance on speculative commentary instead of the clear biblical source.
